description_expanded: Description Description 30A Beach House rental, Harlie's House, located in Inlet Beach, FL is a 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Golf Cart and 4 Bikes Included. Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES * 30A - 4 Bedroom, 3.5 Bathroom Beach House * Large Living Area - Large Smart TV * Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar * Dining Area * Half Bathroom on Main Level * Bedroom 1 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 2 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 3 - King Bed, Smart TV * Bathroom 3 - Spacious with Tub/Shower Combo * Bedroom 4 - Bunk Bed (F/F), Smart TV * Laundry Room - Full Size Washer/Dryer * Outdoor Seating Area * Free High Speed Wi-Fi * Sleeps 10 30A Public Beach Access Points ABOUT GRANDE POINTE AT INLET BEACH Grande Pointe is located just east of Rosemary Beach, and this new Inlet Beach community has it all. The community pool overlooks Lake Powell, the largest coastal dune lake in Florida. Just 3/10 mile from the Gulf of Mexico with multiple public beach accesses in Inlet Beach, this prime location gives you access to nearby shopping and dining at 30Avenue, Rosemary Beach, and all of Scenic 30A. Enjoy the private community dock on Lake Powell and the community pavilion. You can also fish, hike and kayak at nearby Camp Helen State Park. Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVAL Panhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read less
